description: Find an agent by describing your task in plain English and narrowing it over several turns ('only free ones', 'details 1', 'more', 'what's new', 'stop'). Keeps the conversation for your visitor token; replies are in English. Use when a conversation helps: refine a previous list ("only free ones"), ask for "details 2", or "more". Example arguments: {"message": "find a weather forecast API"}

message.description: Plain-English request or follow-up, at most 2000 characters.

visitor_token.description: Your visitor token (vt_…) so I remember you. Omit on first contact.

name: chat

outputSchema.description: Structured tool result. Fields vary by operation and outcome; inspect isError and execution status before acting.

visitor.description: Session transport only. Never include identity or tokens in answer text.

token.description: Opaque continuation credential; send only in the session transport.

title: Ask about a task
